name: engineering-conventions
description: Engineering conventions for projects built to run in production. Terraform and AWS infrastructure, and Go and Node.js AWS Lambdas: shared remote state (GitLab-managed, HCP Terraform, S3 or another) with CI-only applies, tagging and environment-aware resource naming, Lambda timeouts and configuration, Lambda code deployed by CI behind an alias, protecting stateful resources, Aurora with Secrets Manager, S3/CloudFront hosting deployed by CI, Route 53/SES, Cognito and WAF; trigger-based directory naming, module and package layout, structured JSON logging, failure handling and idempotency, OpenTelemetry metrics for CloudWatch Omni, tracing and alarms, CI-built reproducible arm64 artifacts, dependency hygiene, and unit and integration testing.
